matches.rationale: GT1 concerns conflicting definitions of network depth (residual blocks vs. Dense layers, and the correspondence between N and experimental depths 4,8,16,etc.). Pred_1 discusses parameter scaling with width vs. depth, which is a different methodological claim in a different location. No finding addresses the depth definition inconsistency.

GT2 describes an inconsistency between L2-norm and dot-product definitions of the critic output. Pred_2 identifies exactly this defect: it notes the paper uses L2-distance to visualize Q-values but the critic is defined as dot-product, calling this misleading. This is a clear detection despite describing it from the visualization/interpretation angle rather than the definition angle (R3 mechanism vs. symptom).
